description: Publish-outcome metrics over a rolling window (default 30 days): posted/failed/cancelled totals, success rate, per-platform breakdown, and the most recent published posts with permalinks plus their latest stored engagement snapshot (views/likes/comments/shares; available for youtube/tiktok/twitter/threads). Snapshots are stored, not live: call refresh_post_metrics first if the numbers must be current. Optionally scope by brand_id and/or platform.

include_samples.description: Include sample users (email contains "sample"). Default: real data only.

name: post_performance
